name: Skill Tokens #29
description:
A collection of small, smooth tokens, each inscribed with an unknown emblem. When held, the tokens emit a faint warmth and briefly augment the holder's proficiency in a random basic skill. Additional investigation reveals no persistent effects or long-term harm to the user.

EFFECT: Users experience a sudden ability to perform a random basic skill when in possession of one token. The effect dissipates after fifteen minutes, leaving no memory of the acquired skill.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Grants temporary proficiency in basic tasks, such as tying knots or simple arithmetic, for a duration of fifteen minutes upon tactile contact.
TASTE: N/A
PACKAGING: A small, circular metallic tin with intricate, abstract designs etched on its surface. The lid features complex symbols interlaced with Korean text that reads "참여의 빛" (Light of Participation).

RESEARCHER NOTE: Surprisingly, they don't enhance speed-eating, which would explain my last lunch break. Potentially useful for D-class training exercises.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-25 — edition #29 of the permanent record.
